change: Replace the registered convergence gate v1 (last-two-10-epoch-block plateau with tolerance max(1%,0.002) AND final loss <= 25% of first epoch) by v2: (i) noise-aware plateau: |mean(last 20 epochs) - mean(previous 20 epochs)| <= 2 x SE of that difference, SE = sqrt(s1^2/20 + s2^2/20); (ii) learning check: mean loss of the last 20 epochs <= 0.5 x first-epoch loss. The validation-MRR condition (MRR at E >= 0.98 x best) and the registered grid/selection rule are unchanged; selected config stays d=64, lr=0.01, margin=2.0.
reason: v1 had two design defects of the agent's own making: the 75% reduction threshold is unreachable for margin 2.0 with unit-norm entities (loss floor ~0.65, 0/9 runs), and the absolute 0.002 tolerance is below SGD noise of per-epoch mean loss when loss is ~0.01-0.02 (plateau failed 2-4/9 at every epoch for margin 1.0).
scientific_impact: POST-HOC amendment: made after seeing the search results, so the gate is no longer blind. Mitigation: definition derived from sampling noise rather than tuned to data; run once; if v2 also fails S3 stops and contingency C applies. SE ignores SGD autocorrelation, so v2 may be slightly lenient.
contingency_C: Option C (redesign) is triggered if: T1 gate v2 fails at every eval epoch up to 400; T2 quality gate fails (lower 95% CI of model MRR <= frequency baseline) for 3 or more of T02-T10; T3 stability gate FAILS in any bucket with >=10 holdout anchors for 3 or more snapshots; T4 determinism fails (treated as a bug, not C). C scope: mini-batch/Adam optimiser, stability-based epoch rule (cross-seed noise floor vs epoch), margin/normalisation review, Bernoulli negatives.
based_on: explicit user approval 2026-11-18 (option A, record option C if problems occur)
forbidden_downstream_evidence_checked: Decision uses training-loss curves and validation MRR only; no drift, RR, MRR of QA or H1 outcome was used.

scope: S3 backbone: contingency C1-C3 (configs/s3_backbone_v33.yaml, section contingency_c)
change: Pre-register contingency C before running it. C1: among tied configs (score >= top-0.005) pick the one meeting the existing epoch rule (MRR >= 0.98 x best and gate v2 on all 9 runs) at the smallest E. C2: replace the loss-plateau condition by a stability rule: smallest E with noise(E) - noise(next E) <= 0.01 (median cross-seed holdout 1-cos after centred orthogonal Procrustes) on T01/T05/T10; gate v2 becomes diagnostic. C3: new mini-batch Adam TransE (batch 128) with grid d{32,64} x lr{0.001,0.005} x margin{1,2} x negatives{uniform,bernoulli}, C2 epoch rule. Order C1->C2->C3->STOP; escalate only when the epoch rule selects nothing; a train-stage T2/T3 failure stops S3.
reason: User approved C1-C3 with pre-registration; gate v2 failed (T1) because lr=0.01 converges slower than 400 epochs.
scientific_impact: Second and later post-hoc changes to model selection. All variants tried are reported: gate v1, gate v2, margin<=1.0 preview, and whichever C steps run. Known risk of C1: a higher learning rate may raise the cross-seed noise floor, lowering drift sensitivity; it is reported.
based_on: explicit user approval 2026-11-18 ('Đồng ý C1-C3, đăng ký trước rồi chạy')
forbidden_downstream_evidence_checked: Uses validation MRR, training loss and cross-seed embedding stability only; no drift, QA RR/MRR or H1 outcome was used.

scope: S3 backbone: replace the convergence gate by a fixed training budget
change: Adopt option R1: backbone = producer SGD TransE-L2, d=64, lr=0.01, margin=2.0 (the config chosen by the registered search rule), E=400 epochs for every snapshot and seed (13, 37, 101). Convergence (gate v2) is reported as a diagnostic, not a gate. Binding train gates: T2 quality, T3 stability, T4 determinism. Sensitivity analysis over E in {300, 400, 500} is mandatory in S5-S9; a conclusion that changes with E is not reported as a finding.
reason: C1, C2, C3 (pre-registered) all selected nothing; cross-seed noise stays high with every optimiser, mainly because 89-91% of entities have degree <=2. The research design already estimates optimisation noise with the same-snapshot null (S5) and checks detectability with positive controls (S6).
scientific_impact: Third post-hoc change to the S3 protocol. Variants tried and reported: gate v1, gate v2, margin<=1.0 preview, C1, C2, C3. The model is not fully converged at 400 epochs (gate v2 8/9; noise still falls <=0.026 per 100 epochs), so drift noise depends on E.
based_on: explicit user approval 2026-11-18 ('Đồng ý R1, chạy train rồi sang S5–S6')
forbidden_downstream_evidence_checked: Uses validation MRR, loss and cross-seed stability only; no drift, QA RR/MRR or H1 outcome was used.

scope: M2 alignment, null and drift measurement and controls (configs/s5_drift_v33.yaml)
change: Register before measuring: cross-fitted (5-fold) centred orthogonal Procrustes on all persistent anchors, G3 diagnostics (orthogonality <=1e-6, rank fraction >=0.90, fit-holdout gap <=0.65); entity-level null from 6 same-snapshot cross-seed observations (median), leave-target-out, support minimum 50, sparse buckets merged with the adjacent bucket having more entities (tie left); delta_time = median of 3 seeds, signed excess, SED+ with mad_epsilon 1e-4, detection call SED+>=2; negative control (pseudo drift) and positive control (rewired edges at 0.5/1.0 strength on T05->T06 and T09->T10, 10% of entities per bucket); sensitivity over E in {300,400,500}.
reason: Plan S4-S6 after R1. Cross-fitting avoids the downward bias of measuring drift on the entities used to fit the alignment; the controls decide whether a null H1 result is informative.
scientific_impact: Support minimum 50 and mad_epsilon 1e-4 are carried over from the earlier M2 candidate, not re-derived; if the positive control fails, H1 is reported NOT_TESTABLE rather than tuned.
based_on: explicit user approval 2026-11-18 ('Đồng ý R1, chạy train rồi sang S5–S6')

scope: H1 restricted to the degree>=3 stratum (configs/n1_h1_deg3_v33.yaml); S4-S9 for H1 only
change: Adopt option N1: the primary H1 population is the degree>=3 stratum (pre-transition degree). Register before measuring: stratum-specific null (support minimum 30, no merging with degree<3), 7 usable transitions, a stratum positive control (25% of entities injected, strengths 0.25/0.5/1.0, criteria testable_large: sensitivity@1.0>=0.80 and FPR<=0.10 at every E), a complete-support 2/3-hop query panel with per-head cap 3, RR_B outcome (3-seed median, filtered ranking), TWFE with query and transition FE without controls, restricted Webb wild cluster bootstrap (9999 draws), falsification with pseudo drift, LOTO/per-hop/uncapped/E sensitivities, and the rule 'H1 TESTABLE only if testable_large at every E and >=100 informative observations and >=5 clusters'. H2/Arm A/OOV are not run.
reason: S6 showed the estimator cannot detect drift for degree<3 entities (sensitivity 0.01-0.04) but exploratively can for degree>=3 (about 0.95, n=21); N1 tests that stratum with a pre-registered criterion and a larger injected sample.
scientific_impact: Population shrinks to roughly 10% of entities and to 330 (2-hop) + 217 (3-hop) complete-support observations before the head cap and before dropping single-observation queries, so power will be low and MDE is reported. support_minimum 30 was chosen after seeing anchor counts (structure only).
based_on: explicit user approval 2026-11-18 ('Đồng ý N1, đăng ký trước rồi chạy')
